steps.en: The vehicle type is updated automatically
steps.why_en: The type is set only when a notice is created; existing outstanding notices are not updated.
steps.why_id: Tipe hanya diset saat notice dibuat; notice outstanding yang sudah ada tidak diperbarui.

steps.en: Classified notices are suspended under a special code
steps.id: Notice classified ditangguhkan dengan kode khusus
steps.why_en: The suspension code exists but can only be applied at the last reminder stage.
steps.why_id: Kode penangguhan ada tetapi hanya bisa dipasang di tahap reminder terakhir.

steps.en: The number of suspension days comes from a setting
steps.id: Jumlah hari penangguhan diambil dari pengaturan

steps.en: Classified notices are picked by their vehicle type
steps.id: Notice classified dipilih berdasarkan tipe kendaraannya
steps.why_en: This path picks notices by a plate letter pattern, not by the classified type.
steps.why_id: Jalur ini memilih notice dari pola huruf plat, bukan dari tipe classified.

steps.en: A daily job suspends classified notices that need it
steps.id: Job harian menangguhkan notice classified yang perlu

steps.en: Processing follows the updated vehicle type
steps.id: Pemrosesan mengikuti tipe kendaraan yang diperbarui
